Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated Khufu with Khafre and incorrectly stated that Khufu was buried in the Pyramid of Khafre. This misinterpretation of the search snippets contradicted the sources indicating Khufu’s burial in the Great Pyramid (King’s Chamber), leading to an erroneous burial location.
